title: Visitation Policies for Visits to Severely Ill Patients in Hospitals and Care Homes
what_it_is: Visitation Policies for Visits to Severely Ill Patients in Hospitals and Care Homes

sections.label: Hospital visits for severely ill
sections.summary: Hospitals and homes may allow visits for exceptional cases, and MOH made exceptions for severely ill patients to have up to five pre-registered visitors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hospitals and homes have the discretion to allow visits for exceptional cases, for example, if the patient or resident is severely ill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH had made exceptions for severely ill patients in hospitals to have up to five pre-registered visitors.
